name: Belgium
prevalence_note: Safeonweb and Febelfin warnings 2025-2026: fake bank or Card Stop staff asking for card reader codes or collecting cards, itsme approval tricks, and fake tax office threats.
cross_border_note: Under the Belgian Royal Decree enforced by BIPT (2024–2026), carriers block unverified international inbound calls spoofing Belgian geographic and mobile (+32 4xx) numbers; cross-border fraud rings target Dutch-, French-, and German-speaking residents via foreign prefixes, domestic SIM boxes, or SMS/WhatsApp callback lures.

scams.name: Valse bankmedewerker of Card Stop: code van de kaartlezer
scams.name_en: Fake bank or Card Stop staff asking for card reader codes
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security service or Card Stop reports a suspicious payment and asks for card reader codes, sends a courier for the bank card or moves money to a vault account.
scams.legit_en: Belgian banks and Card Stop never ask for card reader codes by phone and never send anyone to collect a bank card.
bait_tactics: Zeggen dat de kaartlezer in een andere kamer ligt en rustig laten uitleggen welke betaling het was
Vragen op welke dag en voor welk bedrag de betaling was

scams.name: Valse helpdesk laat een itsme-aanvraag bevestigen
scams.name_en: Fake helpdesk asking to confirm an itsme request
scams.signals_en: A caller says the owner's access is blocked or needs a security update and asks to confirm a request in the itsme app or to give the itsme code.
scams.legit_en: Banks and government services never ask anyone to approve an itsme request they did not start themselves.
bait_tactics: Zeggen dat de telefoon net opnieuw opstart en vragen wat er precies op het scherm zou moeten staan
Rustig vragen voor welke dienst de aanvraag is

scams.name: Valse FOD Financiën: onmiddellijk betalen of beslag
scams.name_en: Fake tax office demanding immediate payment or seizure
scams.signals_en: A caller posing as the federal tax office or a bailiff claims an unpaid tax debt and threatens seizure today unless money is transferred at once.
scams.legit_en: The Belgian tax office sends letters and never demands immediate transfers by phone under threat of seizure the same day.
bait_tactics: Zeggen dat de briefwisseling bij de boekhouder ligt en vragen om welk jaar het gaat
Vragen hoe het bedrag precies berekend is

scams.name: Faux service de sécurité bancaire : codes du lecteur de carte
scams.name_en: Fake bank security asking for card reader codes (French)

red_flag_keywords.text: code de votre lecteur de carte

scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security service or Card Stop reports a suspicious payment, asks for codes from the card reader or announces a courier to pick up the bank card.
scams.legit_en: Belgian banks never ask for card reader codes by phone and never send a courier to collect a bank card.
bait_tactics: Dire que le lecteur de carte est dans une autre pièce et demander calmement de quel paiement il s'agit
Demander à quelle date et pour quel montant

scams.name: Falscher Card-Stop- oder Bankanruf (Kartenlesegerät & itsme)
scams.name_en: Fake Card Stop or bank security call demanding card reader response code or itsme approval
scams.signals_en: Caller poses in German as Card Stop or a Belgian bank fraud officer targeting East Belgium residents, claiming suspicious card debits were detected and asking the victim to insert their card into the card reader (Digipass/Kartenlesegerät) and read back the...
scams.legit_en: Real Card Stop and Belgian banks block cards directly without calling proactively to request card-reader response codes, PINs, or itsme approvals.
bait_tactics: Sagen Sie ruhig, dass die Batterie vom Kartenlesegerät gerade leer blinkt und Sie im Keller nach neuen Knopfbatterien suchen müssen
Lesen Sie absichtlich eine zu kurze Ziffernfolge vor und behaupten Sie, das Display vom Lesegerät flackere stark
Fragen Sie höflich nach der genauen Abteilung in Eupen oder Sankt Vith und bitten Sie um langsames Buchstabieren
